name: trait alias unqualified
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'ok';}} class C{use A{f as g;}} $o=new C();echo $o->g();

name: trait alias qualified
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 5;}} class C{use A{A::f as g;}} echo (new C())->g();

name: trait alias keeps original
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'a';}} class C{use A{f as g;}} $o=new C();echo $o->f().$o->g();

name: trait alias visibility private
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 11;}} class C{use A{f as private g;} public function run(){return $this->g();}} echo (new C())->run();

name: trait alias visibility only
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 12;}} class C{use A{f as private;} public function run(){return $this->f();}} echo (new C())->run();

name: trait insteadof first
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'A';}} trait B{public function f(){return 'B';}} class C{use A,B{A::f insteadof B;}} echo (new C())->f();

name: trait insteadof second
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'A';}} trait B{public function f(){return 'B';}} class C{use A,B{B::f insteadof A;}} echo (new C())->f();

name: trait insteadof and alias loser
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'A';}} trait B{public function f(){return 'B';}} class C{use A,B{A::f insteadof B;B::f as other;}} $o=new C();echo $o->f().$o->other();

name: trait insteadof other method
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'A';} public function x(){return 'X';}} trait B{public function f(){return 'B';} public function y(){return 'Y';}} class C{use A,B{A::f insteadof B;}} $o=new C();echo $o->x().$o->y();

name: trait nested use
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 41;}} trait B{use A;} class C{use B;} echo (new C())->f();

name: trait nested multi step
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'a';}} trait B{use A;} trait C{use B;} class D{use C;} echo (new D())->f();

name: trait nested own override
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'a';}} trait B{use A;public function f(){return 'b';}} class C{use B;} echo (new C())->f();

name: trait nested property
code: <?php trait A{public $x=2;} trait B{use A;} class C{use B;} echo (new C())->x;

name: trait nested extra method
code: <?php trait A{public function a(){return 'a';}} trait B{use A;public function b(){return 'b';}} class C{use B;} $o=new C();echo $o->a().$o->b();

name: trait alias inherited method override
code: <?php class Base{public function f(){return 'base';}} trait T{public function f(){return 'trait';}} class C extends Base{use T{f as other;}} $o=new C();echo $o->f().$o->other();

name: trait alias method from second
code: <?php trait A{public function a(){return 'A';}} trait B{public function b(){return 'B';}} class C{use A,B{B::b as bb;}} echo (new C())->bb();

name: trait alias static method
code: <?php trait A{public static function f(){return 7;}} class C{use A{f as g;}} echo C::g();

name: trait alias and class override
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'A';}} class C{use A{f as backup;} public function f(){return 'C';}} $o=new C();echo $o->f().$o->backup();

name: trait alias separate use groups
code: <?php trait A{public function a(){return 'A';}} trait B{public function b(){return 'B';}} class C{use A{a as aa;} use B{b as bb;}} $o=new C();echo $o->aa().$o->bb();

name: trait alias nested trait method
code: <?php trait A{public function f(){return 'a';}} trait B{use A{f as g;}} class C{use B;} echo (new C())->g();
